title: Ask your AI about your marketing numbers
intro: Google's official MCP servers let your AI answer questions from your real Analytics and Ads data. Plus a free scheduler for your posts.
reel: From the reel: Marketers, stop exporting reports

tools.name: Google Analytics MCP
tools.what: Ask things like "which page got the most visitors last week?" and it answers from your real Analytics data. It only reads by default; changes need an extra setting.

copy.label: Run it (after the Google setup in the README)

tools.name: Google Ads MCP
tools.what: Ask how your campaigns are doing in plain words. It can also make some changes, so start with the read-only setup the README describes (labels and assets off) until you trust it.

tools.name: Postiz
tools.what: Schedule posts to Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, LinkedIn and more from one place. Free if you run it yourself.

note: The AI reads the numbers. You still decide what to do with them.
